items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Maria Teresa, Floro, Floro Zorilla, he was a good singer.

ctx.x: I see. Okay, now at that time while this is going on, You were aware of music?

Naturally, because my father was a good singer. You know, when I heard Panchito Riset for the first time, I remembered my father; my father had that type of voice, like Panchito Riset, when he was very young; and my house was a musical house because the day of my mother's birthday was a happy thing there, day before, the day and the day after. So we had Maria Teresa, we had Floro and Miguel, we had all the singers, all the popular singers in Havana. They was coming to my house to sing and celebrate my mother's…
Your father used to hire these musicians . . . .
